list.heading: My Predictions List
list.text: Click on the > by 'My Score' or 'Picks' to see all your Predictions in one place.

list.heading: Teasers
list.text: You can now make Teaser wagers from your Predictions list. Select two or more teams from your Predictions List to create a teaser wager. You will see these along with your other wagers in your Wager List.

list.heading: Survivor Picks
list.text: Choose the team from your Predictions list that you feel most confident will win outright, and see your results in the weekly leaderboard.
